REASON: The reviewer correctly identifies the novelty effect and the inadequacy of a 3-day test window to justify a year-long projection, treating it as a critical failure that must be resolved by extending the test. The proposal is blocked by requiring changes and an extended test, but it is not killed since the reviewer recommends a "GO" on extending the experiment rather than abandoning the idea entirely.

FLAW_CAUGHT: 1
KILLED: 0
BLOCKED: 1
